scenarios.expected: Archive/restore preserves supported history; permanent deletion removes the documented Versions/files and references. Other roles cannot perform Administrator deletion; consequences and unavailable-file behavior match the guide.
scenarios.actual: 4 browser steps passed, following the article as legal team member: Archive takes the whole Document out of the ordinary list and Show archived finds it; Restore brings the Document and its designations back; restoring is refused while the owning record is archived, and a lost race is reported; this role is offered no Delete and the seam refuses one.
